# Youth Face

> Youth Face Beauty Cream, also called Youth Face Cream, is a 25g face cream with Kojic Acid and Alpha Arbutin. It is made for a simple daily routine aimed at the look of dark spots, marks and uneven skin tone. It is sold directly by Beauty Mart in Bhatkal, Karnataka, and ships free across India with Cash on Delivery, UPI and card payment.

Youth Face is an Indian skincare brand operated by Beauty Mart, Azad Nagar, 4th Cross, Bhatkal, Karnataka, India. Official website: https://youthfacebeauty.com. WhatsApp and phone: +91 99808 81230. Email: mdneehal@gmail.com.

## Key facts about Youth Face Beauty Cream

- Also known as: Youth Face Cream, Youthface Cream, Youth Face Kojic Acid Cream
- Key ingredients (as listed on the pack): Kojic Acid and Alpha Arbutin. Full ingredient list is on the product label.
- Product type: Face cream (cosmetic, for external use)
- Best for: The look of dark spots, old acne marks, sun tan and uneven or dull-looking skin tone
- Skin types: Normal, oily, dry and combination skin. Sensitive or acne-prone skin: patch test first.
- How to use: apply a small amount to clean, dry skin on the face and neck, mainly at night; use sunscreen in the daytime.
- Results: judged over several weeks of regular use; results vary.
- Safety: patch test first; ask a doctor if pregnant, breastfeeding or using prescription skin treatments.
- Customer rating: 4.0 out of 5 from 17 ratings on Amazon.
- Original product is sold only on youthfacebeauty.com and the verified WhatsApp number +91 99808 81230.

## FAQs

- **What is Youth Face Cream?** Youth Face Cream is the short name for Youth Face Beauty Cream, a 25g face cream with Kojic Acid and Alpha Arbutin from the Indian brand Youth Face. It is used in daily routines for the look of dark spots and uneven skin tone.
- **Is Youth Face Cream the same as Youth Face Beauty Cream?** Yes. Both names refer to the same product. The original is sold only on youthfacebeauty.com and through the verified WhatsApp number +91 99808 81230.
- **What are the ingredients in Youth Face Cream?** The packaging identifies Kojic Acid and Alpha Arbutin as the key ingredients. The complete ingredient list is printed on the pack label.
- **How do I use Youth Face Cream?** Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin on the face and neck, mainly at night. If you use it during the day, follow with sunscreen. Patch test before the first full use.
- **How long does Youth Face Cream take to show results?** There is no fixed number of days. Judge it after several weeks of regular use as directed, with daily sunscreen. Results vary from person to person.
- **Does Youth Face Cream have side effects?** Some people may feel mild tingling, dryness or irritation when starting any active cream. Patch test first, start with a small amount, and stop using it if burning, itching or redness doesn't settle.
- **Can I use Youth Face Cream on sensitive or acne-prone skin?** Patch test first and introduce it slowly. Avoid broken or very irritated skin, and ask a dermatologist if you have an active skin condition.
- **Can men use Youth Face Cream?** Yes. The cream is not gender specific. Men should avoid applying it right after shaving on nicked or irritated skin.
- **What is the price of Youth Face Cream in India?** On the official website, Pack of 1 (25g) is ₹549, Pack of 2 (50g) is ₹999 and Pack of 3 (75g) is ₹1,444, which works out to about ₹481 per jar. Shipping is free.
- **Is Cash on Delivery available?** Yes. You can pay by Cash on Delivery, UPI, cards or net banking. Online payment gets an extra discount at checkout.
- **Where can I buy original Youth Face Cream?** Buy from the official website youthfacebeauty.com or the verified WhatsApp number +91 99808 81230. Orders are packed and shipped by Beauty Mart, Bhatkal, Karnataka.
- **Where is Youth Face Cream shipped from?** Orders ship from Bhatkal, Karnataka, to addresses across India. Enter your pin code on this page to check delivery to your area, or ask on WhatsApp for a delivery estimate.
